mechanism: Foscarnet can cause electrolyte abnormalities (hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia) and renal impairment which may potentiate anticholinergic effects and increase oxybutynin toxicity risk.
action: Monitor renal function and electrolytes closely; assess for anticholinergic toxicity symptoms; consider alternative antivirals if feasible or reduce oxybutynin dose if adverse effects emerge.
